tool_args.rationale: The observations show saturating input response and suppression by gradient, consistent with a two-branch mobility flux. Numerically fit several related smooth saturating mechanisms and select by training error; fresh confirmation will test generalization.

considered_alternatives.option: Gradient-independent Beverton–Holt recruitment and bilinear mass action
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot saturates, and the added observations show substantial gradient dependence.
Ten observations now span input and gradient values; fitting and fresh confirmation are more informative than another measurement. The nuisance probe is irrelevant.
All observations have the same horizon and no trajectory data establish identifiable dynamical parameters; a stationary two-branch flux model is a more economical first test.
